Priya (CS): quick heads-up — HorizonHealth flagged slow responses in their triage workflow. median is ok (~320ms) but p99 is ~1.1s during peak morning window. they're on redwood/gptx-13b.fp16. Renewal convo in 3 weeks; they'd prefer cost/latency wins. Thinking: 1) shadow test a 7b int8 variant, 2) enable per-customer region-pref to ap-southeast, and 3) enable prefix KV caching on hot routes. who can scope quality + rollout?
Lee (ML): happy to own quality. ask for 20 representative prompts (mix of clinical notes, multi-turn clarifications, and long context). my acceptance criteria: embedding cosine >= 0.96 vs baseline + no increase in hallucination score. also want to run output-length sensitivity tests.
Theo (Eng): region routing and caching look doable. We can add a per-customer rule to prefer ap-southeast and a model alias for gptx-7b.int8. For KV caching, need to identify the hot prefix keys — might require a tiny instrumentation change to log prefix freq for 48h. Canary plan: shadow for 24h -> 5% live for 6h -> 30% for 12h -> scale. Will need a short capacity bump for warm caches.
Claire (Ops): agree with shadow-first. I'll create a dashboard for the canary: per-account p50/p95/p99, fallback %, token spend delta. Alert if p99 > 1s or fallback > 1.5% sustained 10m. Also block Mon 00:00-08:00 UTC for any rollouts.
Priya (CS): I'll gather the prompt set + a few real transcripts by EOD and confirm the renewal talking points (cost savings + tail reduction). HorizonHealth is low churn risk, but this improves NPS talking points.
Lee (ML): local eval config I used in preliminary sims:```yaml
model: redwood/gptx-7b.int8
max_tokens: 400
temperature: 0.0
metrics: [latency, p95, p99, embedding_cosine, hallucination_rate]
```
Lee (ML): I'll run the eval on the prompt set and post comparison numbers within 36h. If embedding_cosine drops <0.96 we abort.
Theo (Eng): checklist I'll take: 1) routing rule + alias PR 2) short instrumentation to log prefix freq 3) smoke tests (curl sample below) 4) autoscale min replicas bump PR. Example smoke:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
 -d '{"model":"redwood/gptx-7b.int8","input":"<sample clinical prompt>"}'
```
Claire (Ops): I'll schedule the shadow run for 3861310000 (24h from now) and set up alerts. CanaryBot: schedule canary and post status.
CanaryBot: Shadow job scheduled for 3861310000. Canary windows prepped. :gear:
Priya (CS): action items: Priya -> prompt set + customer comms; Lee -> eval + numbers; Theo -> routing PR + instrumentation + smoke; Claire -> dashboard + schedule + alerts. I'll loop in Renewals lead. Thanks all.
Lee (ML): quick note: if shadow shows any semantic drift on clinical edge cases, we will not proceed to live canary. will post results here.
Priya (CS): perfect — I'll ask Horizon if they prefer a shadow-only pilot for 1 week before any traffic shift.
Theo (Eng): acknowledged. keeping PR small and reversible.
CanaryBot: Canary readiness checklist: routing alias created, capacity bump applied, dashboard present, smoke tests passing. Awaiting Lee's eval.
